title: Agent Introspection

widgets.description: How much of the active seven-day analysis window is linked to a project, filtered by the selected display range.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  round(
    100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(
      attributes_string['entity.id'],
      notEmpty(attributes_string['agent.project.id'])
        AND attributes_string['agent.project.id'] != 'unresolved'
        AND notEmpty(attributes_string['agent.project.name'])
        AND attributes_string['agent.project.name'] != 'unresolved'
    )) / greatest(toFloat64(uniqExact(attributes_string['entity.id'])), 1),
    2
  ) AS `Project attribution coverage`,
  toFloat64(uniqExactIf(
    attributes_string['entity.id'],
    notEmpty(attributes_string['agent.project.id'])
      AND attributes_string['agent.project.id'] != 'unresolved'
      AND notEmpty(attributes_string['agent.project.name'])
      AND attributes_string['agent.project.name'] != 'unresolved'
  )) AS `Attributed observations`,
  toFloat64(uniqExact(attributes_string['entity.id'])) AS `All observations`
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.observation.detected'
  AND notEmpty(attributes_string['analysis.generation'])
  AND attributes_string['analysis.generation'] = (
  SELECT argMax(
    attributes_string['analysis.generation'],
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  )
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.analysis_generation.activated'
)
HAVING count() > 0

widgets.description: Actionable patterns in the active seven-day analysis window, filtered by the selected display range.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  left(attributes_string['entity.id'], 8) AS `Finding`,
  argMax(
    multiIf(
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'tool_failure', 'Tool failure',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'repeated_attempt', 'Repeated attempt',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'transport_instability', 'Transport instability',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'sandbox_friction', 'Sandbox friction',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'turn_correction', 'Turn correction',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'quality_gate_bypass', 'Quality gate bypass',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'command_churn', 'Command churn',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'tool_loop', 'Tool loop',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'token_outlier', 'Token outlier',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'skill_adherence', 'Skill adherence',
    attributes_string['finding.category'] = 'scope_recurrence', 'Scope recurrence',
    attributes_string['finding.category']
  ),
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  ) AS `Category`,
  argMax(
    multiIf(
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'tool_failure', 'Tool failure',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'repeated_attempt', 'Repeated attempt',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'transport_instability', 'Transport instability',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'sandbox_friction', 'Sandbox friction',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'turn_correction', 'Turn correction',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'quality_gate_bypass', 'Quality gate bypass',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'command_churn', 'Command churn',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'tool_loop', 'Tool loop',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'token_outlier', 'Token outlier',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'skill_adherence', 'Skill adherence',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'scope_recurrence', 'Scope recurrence',
    attributes_string['detector.id']
  ),
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  ) AS `Detector`,
  argMax(
    if(
      empty(attributes_string['agent.project.name']),
      'Unresolved',
      attributes_string['agent.project.name']
    ),
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  ) AS `Project`,
  argMax(
    attributes_number['occurrence.count'],
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  ) AS `Occurrences`,
  formatDateTime(
    max(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)),
    '%d %b %H:%i'
  ) AS `Last evaluated`
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN (
  'introspection.trend.evaluated', 'introspection.trend.promoted'
)
  AND notEmpty(attributes_string['analysis.generation'])
  AND attributes_string['analysis.generation'] = (
  SELECT argMax(
    attributes_string['analysis.generation'],
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  )
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.analysis_generation.activated'
)
GROUP BY attributes_string['entity.id']
HAVING argMax(
  attributes_string['trend.state'],
  tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
) = 'actionable'
ORDER BY `Occurrences` DESC, `Last evaluated` DESC

widgets.description: Daily observations by detector in the active seven-day analysis window, filtered by the selected display range.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts,
  multiIf(
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'tool_failure', 'Tool failure',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'repeated_attempt', 'Repeated attempt',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'transport_instability', 'Transport instability',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'sandbox_friction', 'Sandbox friction',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'turn_correction', 'Turn correction',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'quality_gate_bypass', 'Quality gate bypass',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'command_churn', 'Command churn',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'tool_loop', 'Tool loop',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'token_outlier', 'Token outlier',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'skill_adherence', 'Skill adherence',
    attributes_string['detector.id'] = 'scope_recurrence', 'Scope recurrence',
    attributes_string['detector.id']
  ) AS detector,
  toFloat64(uniqExact(attributes_string['entity.id'])) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.observation.detected'
  AND notEmpty(attributes_string['analysis.generation'])
  AND attributes_string['analysis.generation'] = (
  SELECT argMax(
    attributes_string['analysis.generation'],
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  )
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.analysis_generation.activated'
)
GROUP BY ts, detector
ORDER BY ts, detector

widgets.title: Observed signals by detector

widgets.description: Of distinct findings in the active seven-day analysis window, the share that becomes actionable, filtered by the selected display range.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    detector = 'tool_failure', 'Tool failure',
    detector = 'repeated_attempt', 'Repeated attempt',
    detector = 'transport_instability', 'Transport instability',
    detector = 'sandbox_friction', 'Sandbox friction',
    detector = 'turn_correction', 'Turn correction',
    detector = 'quality_gate_bypass', 'Quality gate bypass',
    detector = 'command_churn', 'Command churn',
    detector = 'tool_loop', 'Tool loop',
    detector = 'token_outlier', 'Token outlier',
    detector = 'skill_adherence', 'Skill adherence',
    detector = 'scope_recurrence', 'Scope recurrence',
    detector
  ) AS `Detector`,
  toFloat64(uniqExactIf(finding_id, trend_state = 'actionable')) AS `Actionable findings`,
  toFloat64(uniqExact(finding_id)) AS `All findings`,
  round(
    100 * toFloat64(uniqExactIf(finding_id, trend_state = 'actionable'))
      / greatest(toFloat64(uniqExact(finding_id)), 1),
    2
  ) AS `Actionable yield`
FROM (
  SELECT
    attributes_string['entity.id'] AS finding_id,
    argMax(
      attributes_string['detector.id'],
      tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
    ) AS detector,
    argMax(
      attributes_string['trend.state'],
      tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
    ) AS trend_state
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano
AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN $start_timestamp - 1800 AND $end_timestamp
AND resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN (
    'introspection.trend.evaluated', 'introspection.trend.promoted'
  )
  AND notEmpty(attributes_string['analysis.generation'])
  AND attributes_string['analysis.generation'] = (
  SELECT argMax(
    attributes_string['analysis.generation'],
    tuple(attributes_number['entity.version'], timestamp)
  )
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE resource.`service.name`::String = 'agent-introspection'
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'introspection.analysis_generation.activated'
)
  GROUP BY finding_id
)
GROUP BY detector
ORDER BY `Actionable yield` DESC, `Detector`
